March 5, 2024
Loss reported by the insured driver, who is named on the policy, after a low-speed collision in a parking lot. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and the file was opened with the vehicle and the claimant both identified.
March 11, 2024
Police report and people present at the scene place the claimant in the vehicle at the time of impact. Photos taken at
the scene show some details of the contact, but no independent witnesses have come forward.
March 19, 2024
Repair etsimate reviewed. Most of the damage lines up with the impact described, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior claims or inspections.
July 8, 2024
Claimant's counsel submitted a statement describing neck and back strain following the collision. The reported injury
is plausible for a crash of this type, and the claimant has told the same account in every conversation so far.
September 17, 2024
Medical records received. Treatment followed a usual course, with care tapering off as the claimant improved. No
earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records provided.
September 28, 2024
Checked coverage history. Nothing suggests the damage happened before the policy coverage started, and the
driver is confirmed on the policy as a listed driver.
October 17, 2024
File reveiwed with the supervisor. Liability and injury components are being evaluated on the available evidence, and
the next step is to request the final treatment summary from counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
